title: Lesson 3 Checkpoint — Some & Any
description: Show what you learned about some & any. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.
canDo: I can use some and any with countable and uncountable nouns.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: There is some milk in the fridge.
There is some milk in the fridge.
questions.answer: There is some milk in the fridge.
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Some & Any: Some in positive statements. Any in questions and negative statements. Some in polite offers and requests.

questions.question: Complete: There ___ some milk in the fridge.
questions.explanation: Some in positive statements. Any in questions and negative statements. Some in polite offers and requests.

questions.question: True or false: "There is some milk in the fridge." is correct English.
questions.explanation: This sentence follows the target grammar.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: We don't ___ any sugar.
questions.explanation: Some in positive statements. Any in questions and negative statements. Some in polite offers and requests.
